{{Quote|A similar design was used to imprison the Gen'dai Sith Orvakor, the Trandoshan Hozuk, and several of Tulak Hord's deadliest assassins.|[[Gnost-Dural]], on [[Darth Malgus]]'s prison cell.|<ref name="TOR LOTS" />}}
'''Hozuk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who was imprisoned in a cell similar in design to the one used to imprison [[Darth Malgus]] following the [[Mission to Elom]].<ref name="TOR LOTS" />
